entries.text: AI Usage Dashboard launched. Secret page tracking all provider quotas.
Drone Weather rebuilt — live rain detection, FPV drone flight physics, flocking birds, procedural tree sway, mouse-tracking pilot, breathing sun glow.
Golden Hour Helper — interactive shooting advice phrases, slot-machine spin animation, hero-sized display.
Aspect Ratio Tool — local photo/video previewing, multi-file uploads, native aspect detection.
Stone theme added site-wide. Warm e-ink papyrus palette across all pages.
Scattered added to the reel. Shared internally at Apple — manager praised the music and constraints.
Onboarding Field Guide adopted as team's living document. Co-authored with Lead, presented to full team.
Site design system unified — one stylesheet, one token set, editorial direction. Replaced 11 divergent style blocks.
48 Hour Film Project Detroit 2026 — completed and submitted.
Wheatley switched to Kimi K3. GLM-5.2 demoted to fallback.
Apple career rotation to AOS Digital Experience UAT Lead officially began.
